title: Community models can transcribe audio
summary:
Community speech-to-text models arrived, the model monitor remembers favorites, and four more apps joined the catalog.

Community contributors added speech-to-text models to My Models. OpenAI-compatible transcription upstreams can be registered, selected as audio fallback targets, and used through the transcription API, with usage measured in audio seconds. Related response-format work makes unsupported subtitle requests return a clear error rather than an empty response; AssemblyAI still supports SRT and VTT.

Per-model favorites are back, along with a Favorites-only view and favorites-first sorting. Favorites and scope/type filters now persist across visits.

The app catalog added three image-making apps—DiddyDiffusion, AI Art & Image Generator, and Kokoro Roto—and the educational tool Intelligent Diagnostic Assessment. Kokoro Roto adds anime characters and scenes with mood and format choices.

highlights.title: Bring your own transcription model
highlights.text: Register an OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text endpoint in My Models, then use it for audio transcription or as an audio fallback target. Community transcription models appear in `/audio/models` and `/v1/models`. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Keep favorite models close
highlights.text: Favorite models in the model monitor, switch to a Favorites-only view, and keep your favorites and filters between visits. [Open the model monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).
